profile.headline: Senior Software engineer | Computer Science MSc | Experience in full stack development
profile.summary:
I am a Colombian-American software engineer.
My background in engineering and hands-on experience with programming in different contexts ranging from embedded systems to web development has made me highly adaptable and a quick learner. As such, I can offer a fresh point of view, which is crucial in any group to solve problems creatively.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed the front end of a mobile app in React Native.
- Assisted in the maintenance and improvement of the development pipeline’s infrastructure.
- Learned how to work in an agile team.

positions.title: Systems Evaluation Engineer
positions.description: Continued my work with the team on the same set of tools after the internship was over.

positions.title: Systems Evaluation Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developed software tools related to the automation of medical device hardware testing, which included:
 - Updating a Python web interface for the user to schedule test batches
 - Expanded a, automated regression system in C# that connects testing stations to main controller
 - The update of a test environment handler in Java

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Worked at a startup that provides a web application service for healthcare providers that manages clinical histories, schedules, and financial records. The app is built using ASP.NET MVC. My core activities included:
    - Creating new features and functionalities using CSS, HTML, JavaScript, and C#.
    - Creating data flow algorithms using AJAX and JSON.
    -Collaborating with designers and clients to ensure efficient designs that responded well to real world needs.
    - Updating and expanding upon relational databases using SQL Server.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · ASP.NET MVC · JavaScript · Web Development · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · SQL · Software Development · HTML
